alt: Kuwago leans toward you, joyfully waving one raised wing with a happy open beak.
Kuwago proudly offers an invitation card toward you with both wings.
Kuwago stands wide with head tilted, looking upward while touching its chin; a question spark floats above.
Kuwago sits with its head bowed, reading an open book held low in both wings.
Kuwago leaps with feet off the ground and wings raised in a V as a silver coin and sparkles fly.
Sleepy Kuwago slumps onto a soft pillow with eyes closed and a gentle z curl above.
Kuwago peeks over an edge, showing its upper half while gripping the ledge with both wings.
Kuwago points to the side with one wing while resting the other on its hip.
